pali: 717.Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ "arūpasattakavasenā"ti, tattha ayaṃ mātikā – kalāpato, yamakato, khaṇikato, paṭipāṭito, diṭṭhiugghāṭanato, mānasamugghāṭanato, nikantipariyādānatoti.
english_reference: 76.The headings of what was called above “the immaterial septad” are these: (1) by groups, (2) by pairs, (3) by moments, (4) by series, (5) by removal of [false] view, (6) by abolition of conceit, (7) by ending of attachment.
raw_dharmamitra_output:
७१७।

至於所說的「透過七種非色法（名法）的觀察方式」，其綱目如下：

從聚集成組的角度、從成對的角度、從剎那生滅的角度、從順序的角度、

從剷除邪見的角度、從剷除傲慢的角度、以及從盡除貪愛的角度。
